# Update the SimpleNote 'Venmo Expenses' note content with the computed new_content
from datetime import datetime, date
import calendar

pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pass_map = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in pw_list}

sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='mar_blac@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])['access_token']
note_id = 3084

# Recompute month label + new total (idempotent update)
now_dt = datetime.now()
month_label = f"{now_dt.month:02d}/{str(now_dt.year)[-2:]}"
first_day = date(now_dt.year, now_dt.month, 1)
last_day = date(now_dt.year, now_dt.month, calendar.monthrange(now_dt.year, now_dt.month)[1])
min_created_at = str(first_day)
max_created_at = str(last_day)

venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='mar_blac@gmail.com', password=pass_map['venmo'])['access_token']

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_txns = []
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        raise RuntimeError(resp['message'])
    if not resp:
        break
    all_txns.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

total_sent = round(sum(float(t['amount']) for t in all_txns), 1)

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']

import re
pattern = re.compile(r"^\\s*-\\s*(\\d{2}/\\d{2})\\s*=>\\s*\\$([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)\\s*$")

# Parse existing entries
existing = {}
for line in content.splitlines():
    m = pattern.match(line)
    if m:
        existing[m.group(1)] = float(m.group(2))

lines = content.splitlines()
header = lines[0]
rest = lines[1:]
new_entry_line = f"- {month_label} => ${total_sent:.1f}"

if month_label in existing:
    new_rest = []
    for line in rest:
        m = pattern.match(line)
        if m and m.group(1) == month_label:
            new_rest.append(new_entry_line)
        else:
            new_rest.append(line)
    new_content = header + "\\n" + "\\n".join(new_rest)
else:
    new_content = header + "\\n" + new_entry_line + "\\n" + "\\n".join(rest)

print('Updating note_id', note_id)
print('New entry line', new_entry_line)

update_resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_token, content=new_content)
print('Update response:', update_resp)

# Verify
note2 = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_token)
print('Updated content:\n', note2['content'])
# Quick verification that new entry exists
print('Has new entry?', new_entry_line in note2['content'])
